ammonia.reason: Protein deamination by Brevibacterium linens and yeasts during surface deacidification raises NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Brevibacterium catabolism of methionine and tryptophan to sulfur compounds, p-cresol and indole.

bitter.reason: Moderate accumulation of hydrophobic peptides from rennet and plasmin proteolysis, partly debittered by smear flora.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no C7-C11 2-methyl ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: High moisture and low reducing sugar limit Maillard but baked whole cheese browns via proteins and residual galactose.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus citrate metabolism to diacetyl/acetoin plus high milkfat lactones in thermized cow milk.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis by rennet paste and yeasts releasing butanoic and hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Very high moisture 55% and fat-in-dry-matter ~50% with extensive proteolysis give spoonable paste.

crumbliness.reason: Uncooked washed curd with proteolyzed, high-moisture matrix fractures by flow not crumbs.

firmness.reason: Short-aged unpressed soft paste bound by spruce hoop retains custard-like weak gel.

floral_honey.reason: Limited phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol by yeasts.

fruity.reason: Yeast and smear-bacteria esterification of fatty acids with ethanol to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic/capric acids and no goat-milk branched-chain fatty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Young age limits leucine/isoleucine Strecker degradation to 2-/3-methylbutanal and benzaldehyde.

melt.reason: Deacidified pH ~6.1, high moisture and demineralized paracasein flow readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Geotrichum candidum and smear flora lipoxygenase produce 1-octen-3-ol and earthy pyrazines.

oil_off.reason: 23% fat uncooked emulsion releases free oil when spoonable paste is warmed.

smoky.reason: No wood smoking; only faint resinous alpha-pinene and terpenes migrated from spruce bark box.

sour_vinegar.reason: Most lactic acid consumed by yeasts/Geotrichum during deacidification, leaving low acetic acid.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading and no thermoplastic paracasein alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No high cook of curd so low hydrogen sulfide/dimethyl sulfide; only light methional from smear.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but glycerol, sweet amino acids proline/alanine and diacetyl impart milky sweetness.

umami.reason: Short but intense proteolysis by rennet and smear proteases releases glutamate and savory peptides.
